meta.purpose: Track official and community engagement records that can be merged into civic-action-mapping.json.

sources.name: Porto Alegre Climate Action Plan
sources.relevance: Official climate planning source for mitigation, adaptation, social, economic, environmental, and health priorities.

sources.name: Defesa Civil de Porto Alegre
sources.relevance: Official channel for disaster risk, emergency response, landslide/desabamento support, and public safety information.

sources.name: Orcamento Participativo
sources.relevance: Participatory budgeting process where residents can deliberate regional and thematic demands, including infrastructure and public service priorities.

sources.name: Conselho Municipal de Desenvolvimento Urbano Ambiental
sources.relevance: Urban-environmental council linked to planning, land use, and city development decisions.

sources.name: Conselho Municipal do Meio Ambiente
sources.relevance: Municipal environment council connected to environmental policy formulation, control, and oversight.

sources.name: Conselho Municipal de Mobilidade Urbana
sources.relevance: Consultative council for mobility policy, useful for active mobility and street redesign civic pathways.

sources.name: POA+Drena Resiliente stakeholder engagement plan
sources.relevance: Stakeholder engagement plan for resilient urban drainage investments, including the Arroio Moinho area.

sources.name: POA+Drena Resiliente complaints and repair mechanism
sources.relevance: Formal grievance mechanism for the drainage resilience program, useful for accountability and affected-community feedback.

sources.name: Planning and care for trees
sources.relevance: Official information about urban tree maintenance and care, useful for shade, cooling, and green infrastructure actions.

sources.name: Porto Alegre begins planting 3,500 new trees
sources.relevance: Official tree-planting program signal for green infrastructure and urban cooling pathways.

sources.name: Green, resilient, and inclusive central area requalification PEPI
sources.relevance: Stakeholder engagement plan for a green, resilient, inclusive project in the Historic Center and 4th District.

sources.name: MobiRio
sources.relevance: Local mobility/cycling advocacy group; useful as a community pathway for active mobility, but should be confirmed with current contact details.

sources.name: Bike Anjo
sources.relevance: Volunteer cyclist network that helps people learn and practice cycling; useful for resident-level active mobility pathways.

sources.name: Associacao Gaucha de Protecao ao Ambiente Natural
sources.relevance: Environmental advocacy organization in Rio Grande do Sul; useful for urban tree, environmental policy, and climate accountability pathways.

engagementOpportunities.name: Climate planning and resilience public input
engagementOpportunities.residentAction: Use the climate plan, councils, and participatory budget channels to ask how resilience investments are prioritized by risk, neighborhood, and equity.

engagementOpportunities.name: Drainage resilience project accountability
engagementOpportunities.residentAction: Track POA+Drena Resiliente engagement materials and use the grievance mechanism when project impacts or concerns need formal response.

engagementOpportunities.name: Urban trees and cooling action
engagementOpportunities.residentAction: Connect heat-risk priorities to tree planting, tree care, COMAM oversight, and community advocacy for equitable shade.

engagementOpportunities.name: Active mobility policy and community action
engagementOpportunities.residentAction: Use COMMU and local mobility groups to advocate for safe walking, cycling, accessibility, and street redesign.

engagementOpportunities.name: Emergency preparedness and risk reporting
engagementOpportunities.residentAction: Use Defesa Civil channels for emergency guidance, risk situations, and disaster preparedness.
